annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation 2024/1108 amends Regulation 748/2012 and 2019/945 to extend initial airworthiness certification (Part 21) to unmanned aircraft systems, including their control and monitoring units. It sets which UAS require certification, exemptions for lighter-than-air and research UAS, and applies from 1 May 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends Part 21 type, production and design organisation certification to control and monitoring units (CMUs) and components.
Defines when UAS must be certified: 3 m or larger over crowds, carrying people, dangerous goods, or specific-category risk.
Exempts research/experimental UAS in very limited numbers (permit to fly) and lighter-than-air UAS.
Requires occurrence reporting, airworthiness directives and identification marking for CMUs.
Applies from 1 May 2025, entering into force on the twentieth day after publication.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1108 of 13 March 2024 amending Regulation (EU) No 748/2012 as regards the initial airworthiness of unmanned aircraft systems subject to certification and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
